source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of the exact original XML verse substring, including written/read notes, not a normalized substitute.
source.public_versification_note: Public Deuteronomy 22:30 binds Hebrew 23:1; public 23:1–25 binds Hebrew 23:2–26. All other verses in chapters 19–26 align directly. All 179 original XML records, including written/read and numbering notes, are hashed in full.

key_decisions.decision: Presents the opening events as a hypothetical case, not a command to divorce; leaves something indecent deliberately unspecified.
Locates the actual prohibition after all case conditions; retains the law's defilement language without extending it to every divorced woman.
Preserves both mill and upper-stone restriction and the life image rather than merely calling the object valuable.
Keeps kidnapping, enslavement, sale, Israelite scope, and death as the stated sanction.
Renders tsaraat without equating it with modern leprosy and retains priestly instructions and Moses' command.
Renders collective fathers as parents in this general legal rule, retaining both directions and individual liability.
